briefdescription.para: C++ interface to Zymkey Application Utilities Library.

detaileddescription.para:
1.2.0
Zymbit Technologies, Inc.
This file contains the C++ API to the the Zymkey Application Utilities library, libzkAppUtilsClassCPP. Systems intending to run such applications require that the libzkapputils-c++ package be installed.

This class facilitates writing user space applications which use Zymkey to perform cryptographic operations, such as:
Signing of payloads using ECDSA
Verification of payloads that were signed using Zymkey
Exporting the public key that matches Zymkey's private key
"Locking" and "unlocking" data objects
Generating random data Additionally, there are functions for changing the i2c address (i2c units only), setting tap sensitivity and controlling the LED.

Developers wishing to build applications which utilize the libzkAppUtilsClassCPP library should additionally install the libzkapputils-c++-dev package, which contains the necessary development files for the Zymkey's C++ library. To install this package on a system that does not need to run the applications (e.g. a Docker container or when cross compiling on another architecture), use apt install --no-install-recommends libzkapputils-c++-dev. This will prevent apt from installing the Zymkey's zkifc driver daemon.

Usage: #include <zymkey/zkAppUtilsClass.h> To add libzkAppUtilsClassCPP as a dependency of a CMake-based project, add the following lines to your project's CMakeLists.txt: find_package(zkAppUtilsCXX REQUIRED) target_link_libraries(target_name PRIVATE zkAppUtilsCXX::zkAppUtilsClassCPP) Statically linking to the library is also supported within CMake by way of the zkAppUtilsCXX::zkAppUtilsClassCPP_static link item.
Other projects may likewise configure the library dependency via pkg-config: CFLAGS="$(pkg-config --cflags zkapputils-c++)" LDFLAGS="$(pkg-config --libs zkapputils-c++)"
